caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass bottle with a rounded body that narrows into a tall, multi-ringed neck, and is topped with a spherical stopper. The bottle features intricate decorative details, including a band of circles framed by radiating lines near the widest part, and a geometric pattern of interlocking diamonds and triangles below the band. The stopper is ornamented with carved circles and slight radial glyphs. The shading, rendered in grayscale pencil, provides the illusion of reflectivity and transparency, suggesting the glass material of the object. The background is blank, and the overall composition places the bottle centrally on the page.
title: Decanter
